data.job_title: Systems Architecture Engineer Industrial Technology Platforms & Integration
data.additional_information:
Systems Architecture Engineer
Industrial Technology Platforms & Integration
Location: Hyderabad / Delhi / Remote-Capable Type: Permanent · Full-Time
Compensation: FP1 to FP3 · ₹16 LPA to ₹45 LPA
CTC
Contact: Placement Cell
THE ROLE
Fluxion's technology deployments are not standalone applications. They are distributed systems spanning edge compute nodes on
the plant floor, on-premise servers in control rooms, secure data links, and operator-facing dashboards used by people who have
no interest in the underlying architecture. The systems architecture engineer makes all of this work as a coherent, reliable whole.
This function sits between the domain-specific technology — sensors, AI models, control logic — and the operational reality of
an industrial plant: intermittent connectivity, legacy PLCs, IT security requirements from port trusts, and the need for every
system to degrade gracefully. Getting this right is harder than building the models it supports, and it is where most industrial AI
deployments fail.
WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON
– End-to-end architecture design for Fluxion's industrial AI platforms: data ingestion from field sensors through edge processing to
analytics and operator interfaces
– Edge compute design for latency-critical applications: real-time control advisory systems, breakout detection, and autonomous
vehicle coordination
– Integration work with legacy industrial systems: SCADA, DCS, historian databases, and PLC data extraction using OPC-UA,
MQTT, and protocol bridges
– Data pipeline architecture: schema design, buffering strategies, data quality monitoring, and backfill handling for connectivity gaps
– Security design for industrial control environments: network segmentation, access control, and audit logging
– System reliability design: redundancy, failover behaviour, monitoring and alerting, and recovery procedures for production-critical
deployments
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
– Final year or recent graduate in computer science, electrical engineering, electronics, or a related technical discipline from a
recognised institution
– Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, networking, and operating systems — you understand what happens below the
application layer
– Any prior exposure to industrial systems, embedded platforms, or operational technology through internship, research, or personal
projects
– Comfort producing technical documentation and explaining system design decisions clearly
– Exposure to containerisation, time-series data systems, or ICS security is a meaningful advantage
COMPENSATION & CONDITIONS
This position is offered on the Fluxion Professional pay scale. Entry level hires join at FP1 (₹16 LPA CTC) or FP2 or FP3 (up to
₹45 LPA CTC) based on performance during the selection rounds. All components of the CTC are discussed and agreed at the
offer stage. Roles involve travel to industrial sites, port terminals, and project locations across India; all travel and accommodation
are covered by Fluxion.
